observations: Photo 0 shows a digital piano with a white and black keyboard, a control panel with buttons and a volume knob, and wood-grain side panels. The piano is on a stand, with a snare drum and part of a bass drum visible below. Another keyboard wrapped in plastic is stacked above.
Photo 1 is similar to photo 0, showing the same piano from a slightly different angle. The control panel is visible, and the brand name 'KORG' is readable on the left side of the panel.

Photo 2 is a closer view of the control panel and keys. The model name 'SP-20' is clearly visible on the right side of the control panel. The keys appear clean, and the panel shows some minor scuffs and marks. The wood-grain finish is visible on the right side.

claims.claim: Korg brings a heightened level of realism and feel to its line of portable digital pianos
claims.evidence: This is a marketing statement; the photos show the physical piano but cannot verify the realism or feel.

risks.risk: The piano may not be functional or may have internal issues such as dead keys, sound problems, or power issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the piano being powered on, keys being pressed, and sound output, including a full range of keys and volume control.

risks.risk: The piano may have hidden damage or wear not visible in the photos, such as internal component failure or structural damage to the stand or casing.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the back panel, internal connections, and stand structure, including any signs of damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

risks.risk: The piano may be missing accessories such as a power adapter, sustain pedal, or stand parts.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing all included accessories laid out next to the piano.

proof_requests: Video of the piano being powered on and played, showing all keys and functions working.
Photo or video of the back panel and included accessories.
Close-up of any visible damage or wear on the casing or stand.
response.reason: The brand and model are identifiable from the photos, but the functionality and condition cannot be confirmed without additional proof. The piano must be tested to verify it works and to assess any hidden damage or missing parts.
